intro.desktop: Rivals is a deckbuilding boardgame based on a Battle Royale gameplay. You play the chosen one of your clan and fight to save your people from extinction.
intro.mobile: Rivals is a deckbuilding boardgame based on a Battle Royale gameplay.

description.title: At the dawn of 3221
description.texte: Humanity is all over the galaxy. After centuries of research, science finally unraveled the secret of hyperspeed.
description.texte2: The Network, supreme political council, sealed the destiny of all clans. In order to avoid the conflicts and wars to come, each clans located on each planet of the Milky Way will designate an Ashak to stand for them in the WildTech, a hybrid arena : half-real, half-digital.
description.texte3: You embody one of these Ashaks and will carry your clan's hopes. The ultimate battle is yet to come and no one wants to discover what is hiding beyond the void.

gameplay.deckbuilding.description: + than 150 cards to build a competitive deck.
gameplay.battleroyale.description: The WildTech, a half-real, half-digital arena, is made of 42 tiles.

pirate.cybernetique.name: Cyber hacking
pirate.cybernetique.descriptif: Discard one card from your target's hand.

battle.royale.description2: Build an arsenal worthy of the name, anticipate the evolutions of the game and adapt to the tricks of your oponents !  Camper or clinch, advanced weapons or psychic powers, what strategies will you adopt ?
battle.royale.description3: Last survivor in the arena or first player to earn all the Rivals points ? Save your clan, history is written by the winners.

gameplay.intro: Rivals is played in several rounds, each divided into two rounds of play. During their turn, players have 2 action points to move, collect resources from a tile, play cards from their hand and interact with sponsors.

description.1: Follow the state of your opponents by consulting their boards. Health points, Ultimate charge, available Skills, take these elements into account to adapt your strategy.
description.2: Add Skills to your Ashak board to develop your power, increase your actions and your draw.

description1.part2: Explore, move and reap the tiles to prepare for your confrontations by refining your deck and building a solid defense! Don't overlook resources, they can save your life and win the game.

description2.part3: says unpredictability. Map tiles are never laid out the same way. Events will spice up the game! It's up to you to take advantage of it. At the end of each round, areas are disintegrated with everything it contained... Staying on the edge of the WildTech can prove fatal, but to venture into it too deeply too.

description3.part3: will appear ! Reach those fierce merchants first to get victory points and bonuses like unique cards. Once the transaction is complete, these disappear for fear of getting caught in the crossfire.

exploration.description: The Ashak can reveal all the tiles adjacent to the hex he is on.

move.action: Grab the Ashak token and move it.
move.description: Ashaks move from hex to hex. A move costs 1 action point and is limited to 2 hexes.

finish.text: You have looted all the tiles. At this rate you better come face the other Ashaks by joining the next Rivals on Discord and Tabletop Simulator !

grenade.flash.title: Grenade: Flash
grenade.flash.description: during their next turn, the wounded ashaks roll a dice before each action. if it is unsuccessful, the action is cancelled and AP are lost.

bone.cracker.title: Bone Cracker
bone.cracker.description: Move 1 hex towards your target before your attack unless you are on the same hex.

fin.stratege.title: Strategist
fin.stratege.description: Draw 2 cards then discard one card.

aura.magnetique.title: Magnetic aura
aura.magnetique.description: Until the beginning of your turn, when you are wounded, ignore 1HP loss.

expert.topo.title: topographic expert
expert.topo.description: +1AP to loot, move or interact with a sponsor.

maitre.des.echos.title: Master of echoes
maitre.des.echos.description: draw 1 additionnal card at the beginning of each round.
